gate_definitions.deep_grill: Owner-facing product decisions remain; source facts alone do not choose the AnkiScape loop.
gate_definitions.source_audit: The AnkiScape shape is settled, but exact pre-cutoff mechanics or values are incomplete or conflicting.
gate_definitions.darkan_preferred: A stable high-fidelity Darkan restoration would materially reduce guesswork for hidden server behavior; historical evidence still must be reconciled.
gate_definitions.implementation: Design and evidence are sufficient for a bounded backend/frontend/assets/tests slice.
gate_definitions.dependency: The feature waits on another skill, activity, economy, or acquisition system.

skills.name: Attack
skills.notes: Combat XP routing and styles are live; registry/hub identity, weapon coverage, special attacks, and full target/equipment parity remain. Existing Combat grill governs the loop.

skills.name: Constitution
skills.notes: Damage-based XP, lifepoints, food, death, recovery, and HUD state are live; full consumable, overheal, regeneration, and equipment parity remain.

skills.name: Defence
skills.notes: Defensive and controlled XP routing plus defence bonuses are live; registry naming, equipment requirement coverage, set effects, and full combat parity remain.

skills.name: Magic
skills.notes: Standard elemental combat spells and staff substitution are live. Noncombat spells, spellbooks, enchantment, teleports as abstracted dependencies, alchemy, curses/gates, and the normal skill surface need a dedicated continuation grill.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.notes: A partial maximalist grill exists in memory-bank/ankiscape-skill-expansion.md, but open decisions remain for uptime, curses, altars, Ectofuntus, Wilderness risk, and activity placement.

skills.name: Ranged
skills.notes: Standard bows/arrows, ammo use, styles, XP routing, and loadouts are live; thrown weapons, crossbows/bolts, special attacks, ammo effects, and equipment breadth remain under the existing Combat design.

skills.name: Strength
skills.notes: Aggressive/controlled XP routing and melee max-hit logic are live; remaining work is shared Combat/equipment/source breadth rather than a new loop design.

skills.name: Summoning
skills.notes: Needs charm/secondary acquisition, pouch creation, points, familiars, timers, specials, beasts of burden, combat integration, death/undo, and target UI.

skills.name: Construction
skills.notes: Needs a no-world-map house abstraction, rooms/hotspots/furniture, build/remove loops, servants, material economy, house services, storage, and Prayer/Farming dependencies.

skills.name: Farming
skills.notes: Needs patch abstractions, review-clock growth, disease/death/protection, compost, payments, harvesting yields, tools/seeds, patches, and the parked Herblore Habitat seed.

skills.name: Agility
skills.notes: Needs course/lap/checkpoint abstraction without persistent location, fail/damage behavior, shortcuts as dependency gates, run-energy effects, tickets/rewards, and activity UI.

skills.name: Dungeoneering
skills.notes: Needs a full floor/session abstraction, party-solo boundary, rooms/doors/keys/skills/combat, binds, prestige/complexity, deaths, rewards, tokens, and dungeon-only item lifecycle.

skills.name: Slayer
skills.notes: Enemy metadata exists, but assignments, masters, task pools, XP, streaks, points, skips/blocks, reward shop, task-only targets, protection items, and Combat UI remain.

skills.name: Thieving
skills.notes: Needs pickpocket/stall/chest/door families, success and stun/damage, loot tables, gloves/blackjacking, quest/route gates, inventory/banking, and target organization.

skills.name: Mining
skills.notes: Ordinary skill is live. LRC, Shooting Stars, Wilderness/brawling effects, and remaining special acquisition/reward mechanics remain.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.notes: Ordinary skill is live. Arctic pine/eucalyptus/cursed magic processing, target-local Wilderness effects, and downstream nest/Farming links remain; canoes are explicitly excluded.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.notes: Ordinary methods are live. Cave eel, Trawler, Fish Flingers, Dungeoneering fish, and activity/reward mechanics remain.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.notes: Core smelting/forging and cannonballs are live. Artisan's Workshop, Blast Furnace, Goldsmith gauntlets, burial/ceremonial systems, and special equipment effects remain.

skills.name: Crafting
skills.notes: Large source-backed recipe surface is live. Missing acquisition chains, orb charging/Magic dependencies, temporary boosts, and broader equipment/use effects remain.

skills.name: Fletching
skills.notes: Core whittling, ammunition, broad unlocks, and crossbows are live. Temporary boosts, Barbarian unlock integration, special ammunition/enchantment dependencies, and acquisition breadth remain; OSRS javelin construction is excluded.

skills.name: Firemaking
skills.notes: Line fires and light-source actions are live. Bonfires/fire spirits, pyres, beacons, Barbarian unlock integration, and Wilderness/equipment effects remain.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.notes: Core foods and lava eel are live. Karambwan/gnome chains, Gnome Restaurant, gauntlet burn curves, bonfire/fire interactions, and remaining acquisition routes remain.

skills.name: Runecrafting
skills.notes: Standard/combination/tiara/hood/pouch systems are live. Runespan, ZMI friction, Great Orb Project, Wicked hood dailies, Abyss routing, and rune economy links remain.

skills.name: Hunter
skills.notes: V1 targets are live. Tracking, pitfall, rabbit snaring, grenwall rewards, route semantics, and Farming-dependent Habitat/Jadinkos remain.

skills.name: Herblore
skills.notes: Core three-stage Herblore and Overload mixing are live. Sanfew Serum, weapon poison chains/use, potion boost decay, Prayer/Summoning/Farming dependencies, and missing secondary acquisition remain.

programs.name: Eleven shipped-skill parity backlog
programs.notes: Keep the detailed 43-card ledger; 22 are merged, 19 remain active/parked/split, and two are explicit exclusions.

programs.name: Combat, bosses, equipment, and six partial combat skills
programs.notes: The main loop is already grilled. Finish ordinary enemy breadth, equipment/specials/set effects, bosses and instanced encounters, remaining spell/ammo families, Wilderness risk, and skill-registry reconciliation.

programs.name: 194-quest fidelity program
programs.notes: Audit every quest's authentic stages, branches, transformations, combat, rewards, journals, unlocks, and missing-skill gates. Prefer waiting for stable high-fidelity Darkan quest restoration where historical sources cannot prove server behavior.

programs.name: Activities, minigames, D&Ds, and reward shops
programs.notes: Grill each activity family separately. Include source currencies, run states, rewards, shops, random/event structure, undo, and the global review clock; avoid inert reward stubs.

programs.name: Bosses and instanced combat
programs.notes: Fight Caves/Kiln, Barrows, God Wars, Corporeal Beast, Nex, quest bosses, and activity bosses must stay context-gated rather than ordinary farm targets.

programs.name: Grand Exchange, acquisition coverage, and reward currencies
programs.notes: NPC shops are live. GE design is locked but waits for broader skill/item coverage. Reward shops wait for their activities; missing drops/ground spawns/skill outputs remain a separate acquisition audit.

programs.name: Achievement diaries, clue scrolls, collections, and one-time claims
programs.notes: Generic achievements and Bank Claims exist; full diary regions/tasks/rewards, clue steps/caskets, collection tracking, and one-time world rewards need source and UI programs.

programs.name: Random events and timed world/D&D content
programs.notes: Use the 240-reviews-per-day global clock only for world/economy cadence. Grill each event's visibility, entry, expiry, rewards, and missed-event behavior; do not create a world map.

programs.name: Level 1-99 time and economy balance
programs.notes: After all skills and major methods are present, derive ordinary-efficient 2012 guide XP/hour envelopes and tune Anki pacing separately from source base XP.

programs.name: Packaging, migration, performance, accessibility, and manual QA
programs.notes: Run full pure/Qt suites, manual Anki review flows, migration fixtures, performance checks, packaging/license audit, recovery/export checks, and decide personal-fork versus public-release scope.

programs.name: Stable Darkan restoration ingestion
programs.notes: Observed local dev at 55a7afa29 and ahead of origin during an active restoration series. Do not pin moving work as final parity evidence; wait for a stable milestone, then diff relevant mechanics and reconcile against pre-cutoff wiki/cache evidence.

explicit_exclusions: Standalone transportation networks and persistent world-map/player-location state
Post-cutoff or OSRS-only mechanics without independent pre-EOC proof
Visible inert target/reward rows that do not work end to end
Wall-clock conversion of ordinary skilling reviews into simulated minutes
